title: Persistent Memory
description: A persistent cross-session memory node that retains data across pipeline
invocations. Supports Redis for production and in-memory backends for
testing. Provides session management, keyed storage, history tracking,
and automatic summarization of older entries.

input.description: Questions are enriched with session memory context before forwarding

output.description: Questions with memory context attached in metadata

input.description: Answers are stored in session memory for future retrieval

memory_persistent.redis_password.title: Redis Password

memory_persistent.session_ttl_hours.title: Session TTL (hours)
memory_persistent.session_ttl_hours.description: How long sessions persist before auto-expiry (0 = no expiry)

memory_persistent.max_history.title: Max History Entries
memory_persistent.max_history.description: Maximum history entries per session before auto-summarization

memory_persistent.auto_summarize.title: Auto-Summarize
memory_persistent.auto_summarize.description: Automatically summarize older history entries when limit is reached
